cues: The afferent arteriole bringing blood in is wider than the efferent arteriole taking it out.
So blood backs up in the glomerulus, and its pressure stays high.
That pressure is what drives filtration.
text: Look at the blood vessels. The afferent arteriole bringing blood in is wider than the efferent arteriole taking it out. So blood backs up in the glomerulus, and its pressure stays high. That pressure is what drives filtration.
